title: BadCustodyFeedbackSignal
description: FeedbackSignal kind emitted when an agent's signing key is detected in a non-witnessable secret store (e.g., plaintext repo file). Source of truth: Holochain DHT (elohim zome's existing FeedbackSignal entry type via signal_kind vocabulary; no new DHT entry type). Canon: genesis/docs/architecture/stewardship-over-sovereignty.md §4 (cryptography as accelerator, not gate; substrate-minimum is 'witnessable secret store').

target.description: CID or agent identifier of the agent whose key custody is suspect.

declarer.description: CID or agent identifier of the observer that detected the bad custody (typically a steward, the operator's elohim-counsel, or a network witness).

evidence_url.description: Optional URL pointing at the evidence (a public commit, a config file path, etc.). Always public so the breach is auditable.
